metadata.title: That 1 kill where even Valorant’s confused like ‘Wait, who gave you permission?’
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just steal a kill out of nowhere?
Enemy probably hit the eject button mid-fight.
Click if your aim’s a hot mess but kills still happen.
Valorant logic doing its usual weird magic.

Tap if you’ve ever got a kill you didn’t even earn!

#valorant #luckshot #funnygaming #gamingfails #shorts
